Compensation You May Be Entitled To After a Catastrophic Injury When negligence changes your life forever, the law recognizes that money can’t undo harm but can ease the burden. Mistakes to Avoid After a Catastrophic Injury in Louisiana In the chaos following a serious accident, certain actions can sabotage your claim. Watch out for: Saying “I’m sorry” or accepting blame at the scene Skipping the doctor or postponing treatment Broadcasting details about your accident on social media Taking calls from insurance adjusters before consulting a personal injury attorney Letting the clock run out on your filing deadline Already stumbled? Don’t panic—call us immediately, and we’ll work to protect whatever recovery remains possible. Understanding Louisiana Catastrophic Injury Laws Time is not on your side after a catastrophic injury. Minimum Insurance Requirements in Louisiana: $15,000 per person for bodily injury $30,000 per accident for bodily injury $25,000 for property damage Reach out today to discuss how these laws affect your situation during a free consultation with a Louisiana catastrophic injury lawyer.
